title: On smooth self similar solution to compressible Euler equation with physical vacuum
summary: We consider the barotropic Euler equations in dimension $d > 1$ with decaying density at spatial infinity. The phase portrait of the nonlinear ODE governing the equation for spherically symmetric self-similar solutions has been introduced in the pioneering work of Guderley. The existence of smooth decaying solutions through the sonic line has been obtained in the work (F. Merle et al., 2022) in a suitable range of parameters.
